title: Recipe
description: Canonical, versioned recipe specification (Just-in-Time Derived Data Product Architecture v2, Section 2-3).

version.description: Immutable version for this spec, e.g. 1.0, 2.3

kind.description: Recipe kind per Section 2. Feature/model and Process are out of scope for POC Iteration 1.

status.description: Publication status per Section 3. Always paired with use_scope.

use_scope.description: Declared uses this status covers, e.g. ['exploratory_bi']. Verified for exploratory BI does not imply filing approval.

owner.description: Domain owner accountable for intended scope and limitations.

uses.description: Dependencies on other recipes, forming a DAG. Composite recipes reference one or more.

parameters.description: Parameters this recipe accepts at request time.

grain.description: Explicit output grain, e.g. 'product_version x month x young_driver_segment'.

time_semantics.description: As-of / knowledge-cutoff behavior. Required for any recipe touching effective-dated FDPs.

knowledge_cutoff_param.description: Name of the parameter carrying the knowledge cutoff, if any.

as_of_behavior.description: How the recipe interprets time. Must be explicit and unambiguous (validator rejects ambiguous as-of).

output.description: Named output fields with types and, where applicable, units.

implementation.description: Executable implementation, per target engine. Atomic recipes carry per-engine source tables; composite recipes derive their join/aggregation from 'uses' via the compiler, shared across engines since the expressions here are ANSI-compatible.

engines.description: Per-engine physical binding. Key is the engine name; POC Iteration 1 executes on duckdb. snowflake is declared for later-phase cutover but not wired to a live connection yet.

join_on.description: For composite recipes: column name(s) shared by every dependency's output, used to join their CTEs.

output_expressions.description: For composite recipes: maps each declared output field name to a SQL expression over dependency aliases, e.g. {"bind_rate": "bound_count / NULLIF(eligible_count, 0)"}. Written in ANSI SQL shared across engines.

group_by.description: For composite recipes: expressions to GROUP BY, aliased to a dependency's output column.

tests.description: References to fixtures under tests/fixtures/ used by the analyst test workbench.

limitations.description: Known limitations or exclusions travelling with the recipe (Section 1, explicit scope principle).

source_table.description: Fully qualified table for this engine, e.g. quote_fdp.quote_journey (duckdb) or QUOTE_FDP.QUOTE_JOURNEY (snowflake).
